_comment: ts-watch watermark — the diff baseline. Advances only when a human merges a ts-watch PR. contentHashes ship SEEDED with the live page's baseline (taken 2026-07-10), so the first run only reports genuine drift; a URL added later without a hash reports 'DOC new' until its baseline merges. skippedVersions / features.deferred let a reviewer say 'stop proposing this' by editing here during PR review. Duplicate-PR prevention is NOT tracked here (a field on main would always be stale) — runs must check `gh pr list` for an open ts-watch/* PR first. server.js does not serve this file.
